dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Multiple high-contrast rows of thick white margins visible across the covert feathers, creating a tiered banded appearance.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Very sharp and prominent white boundaries along the edges of dark brown to blackish flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Visible linear transition where the uniform gray texture of the crown meets the high-contrast scaled pattern of the mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent thick, light-blue conical beak and a high-contrast black patch covering the lores, eye, and chin.
